mealBalanceCheck.heading: Meal Balance Check
mealBalanceCheck.subtitle: Messenger / email | £39
mealBalanceCheck.highlight: A quick expert review of your current diet — with personalised suggestions you can start using right away.
mealBalanceCheck.description: This service gives you a clear picture of how balanced your meals are, where you might have gaps in nutrition, and what small changes can make a real difference to your energy levels and overall wellbeing.
mealBalanceCheck.idealIf: You want a simple, affordable starting point — without a full consultation — to understand whether your current diet is working for you.
step1Bullets: Take photos of everything you eat and drink for 5 days
Include meals, snacks, and drinks — no need to weigh anything
step2Bullets: Analyse meal balance, protein, fibre and key nutrient gaps
Check food combinations and meal timing
Identify areas that may affect energy, digestion or mood
step3Bullets: Clear, practical tips you can apply straight away
A guide on how to build balanced meals
Advice on foods and supplements to improve nutrient intake
mealBalanceCheck.followUp: After receiving your feedback, you'll have 3 days of follow-up support via messenger to ask questions and clarify recommendations.
mealBalanceCheck.important: This service provides general nutrition feedback based on your food diary. If you have chronic conditions, digestive disorders, food allergies, or take prescribed medications, a full consultation may be more appropriate.
